facts.business: Vashishtha Luxury Fashion Limited operates as a 100% Export House specializing in high-fashion hand embroidery, finished garments, and couture fashion accessories for global fashion houses across the US, UK, Europe, and Turkey.

segments.name: Manufacturing and export of embroidery and fashion-related products

capacity_or_capex.item: Multihead High Tech embroidery Machine / multihead flat embroidery machine

guidance_or_targets.statement: Moving into FY 2026–27, Vashishtha Luxury Fashion Limited plans to leverage its expanded capital base and listing status to scale production capacities, deepen relationships with global luxury brands, and enhance manufacturing automation.
guidance_or_targets.metric: Production capacity scaling, client relationships, manufacturing automation

key_risks: Raw Material & Operating Cost Volatility: Fluctuations in input costs and currency exchange movements
Client Concentration Risk: Dependency on key international couture brands
facts.related_party_note: Investment in Vashishtha Embroideries Private Limited, a subsidiary of the Company, is carried at cost in the standalone financial statements.
